physicalEvidence.summary: Physical 20. Full CVPR 2026 3PT trains two transformers conditioned on 3D CAD prompts for detection and 6D pose refinement. Chen and lead author Agastya Kalra have Intrinsic/UHM affiliations; the complete CV lists Kalra as his current PhD student. This establishes attributable collaborative robot perception, not ownership of the industrial arms in Hawaii or visitor access. No learned low-level controller or VLA policy is claimed. Local farm and tactile demonstrations are not used to inflate this cap.

shortVisit.summary: Visitor 0. CIRP asks people not to email about openings unless they previously worked with a PI collaborator or published relevant work in a listed major venue. Applicants must independently check whether they meet this condition. The separate graduate-admission and current-UH MS/undergraduate routes do not establish an external-master visitor invitation. Summer 2027 capacity, duration, funding and remote availability are unknown.
